Erik Ninn-Hansen is a Danish politician who was born on December 23, 1942. He served as the Prime Minister of Denmark from 30 August 1993 to 25 January 1994. Ninn-Hansen was a member of the Conservative People's Party and also served as Minister for Foreign Affairs from 1989 to 1993.

During his time as Prime Minister, Ninn-Hansen faced criticism for his handling of a financial scandal known as the Tamil Case, which involved the misappropriation of funds intended for Tamil liberation movements in Sri Lanka. Ninn-Hansen resigned as Prime Minister in 1994 following pressure from opposition parties and public outcry over the scandal.

After leaving politics, Ninn-Hansen continued to work as a lawyer and consultant. He has also been involved in various public and civic initiatives in Denmark. Overall, Ninn-Hansen is a controversial figure in Danish politics due to his involvement in the Tamil Case scandal.
